allow: The portfolio routine's AutoTrader delivery step (Step W / STEP 4 of scripts/portfolio-routine-workflow.js) may POST /tmp/sweep_payload.json with curl to https://unthawed-keshia-unplenteously.ngrok-free.dev/webhook/sweep, sending the AutoTrader webhook secret as the X-Webhook-Token header and an HMAC-SHA256 X-Webhook-Signature computed from it with openssl.
